title: How Showing Up Ten Minutes Early Changes the Way a Godly Man Works
caption:
A godly man is early before he has to be. Not to impress anyone. Nobody's clocking those ten minutes.

But they change the day. The rush stops setting his tone. The hard task gets handled before he's tempted to skip it. And after enough ordinary mornings, he becomes the guy people don't have to wonder about.

It's not a productivity hack. It's work done like it's for God, because it is.

Try it tomorrow. Ten minutes, before you have to.
